parsed.answer: Immediately after the August 8 meeting, Mara's Larch project was still approved for batch delivery using BATCH-0-741. The August 8 meeting tested REPLAY-0-632 but did not approve any change of delivery mode; the switch to STREAM-0-286 came later, on August 15.

citations.quote: They chose BATCH-0-741 for batch delivery.
No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
2026-08-15. Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286.
